name: The Blind

abilities.name: Smack
abilities.description: A basic melee attack that cleaves, in different directions indicated by red cones, dealing moderate physical damage.

abilities.name: Condemn
abilities.description: The Blind levitates into the air and crashes back down, indicated by a large growing red circle, dealing very high physical damage. This attack can be interrupted with Catatonic Disruptor synergy, if it's unlocked by solving third Fa-Nuit-Hen's puzzle.

abilities.name: Splintered Glass
abilities.description: The Blind channels a spell with her hand, causing glass shards to burst at targets' locations as indicated by growing red circles around them, dealing high physical damage and more if multiple targets overlap. The shards linger afterward, dealing continuous moderate physical damage if stepped into.

abilities.name: Shard Shift
abilities.description: At 80%/60%/40%/20% health, the Blind teleports at the edge of the arena and becomes untargettable. At 80%, she summons four Blind Shards, four massive untargettable glass skeletons, at the southern end of arena which will continuously cast their abilities until the end of the battle.

abilities.name: Gleaming Deluge
abilities.description: Starting from 80% of the Blind's health, Blind Shards will cast area-of-effect waves of glass, slowly rolling across the arena. Under 20% of the Blind's health, the intensity of this ability increases, leaving only a winding, one lane wide corridor free of glass waves. This ability can be negated by using Zephyrus Obscuris synergy, if it's unlocked by solving first Fa-Nuit-Hen's puzzle.

abilities.name: Piercing Beam
abilities.description: Starting from 60% of the Blind's health, Blind Shards may cast beams that cover the entire arena lane in front of them, dealing continuous high physical damage.

abilities.name: Summon
abilities.description: Starting at 90% health, Mirrorplasms are summnoned to help The Blind. Starting at 60% health, Glass Remnants are summoned as well.

summary: This article is about the boss. For the set, see The Blind (set). The Blind is a Dremora and the leader of the Blind Path cult. She has lead her cult to Bedlam Veil to steal the so-called Echonir from the Skyvaults and Fa-Nuit-Hen
